log: 2026-08-26 — PIPELINE PROVEN, with a caveat worth more than a pass. Ran the real img2threejs pipeline end to end on the hound: state gate, detail inventory (18 details, every one bound to a component — the validator rejected 4 prose-only ones), PBR evidence above threshold, strict-quality spec, generated factory, turntable + interior-difference + part-coverage gates, review history with recorded regressions. VERDICT: materially better FORM (SDF fusion gives one watertight organic skin with real rib/haunch mass; tapered sweeps give lofted limbs) but it stopped at pass 3 of 7 scoring itself 0.55 and calling refine-spec — the material and lighting passes, where most of the AAA look lives, never ran. INTEGRATION SOLVED: the factory emits 129 draw calls (32x our <=4 target) but rig.js's existing merge collapses it to 1 draw call / 1 material / 11,914 tris / 13 bones in ~30 lines. Three environment traps documented in tools/out/i2t-hound/PIPELINE-NOTES.md, incl. vite.config watch.ignored='tools/out/**' silently serving stale renders.

2026-08-26 — creatures-1 landed (partial): hound + sentinel rebuilt from their Tripo references, and two ROOT-CAUSE finds worth more than the models — (1) the enemy aether cap was luminance-only, and luminance weights blue at 0.07, so a violet at luminance 0.62 still carried a 2.2 blue channel: the exact same class of bug as the witchlight fungus, now capped per-CHANNEL after saturating; (2) the third blob cause is NOT in enemies at all — traced to VFX.js:656 firing a PointLight intensity 6 at 1.2 m from the camera, 48 times in 12 s. Also found a latent bug where paw claws were mirrored onto the opposite leg. Gate PASSED at both qualities.

2026-08-26 — USER VERDICT on the converted Empyrean Gate: not impressive. Diagnosed against the Tripo reference side by side and they are right — the conversion kept the massing (podium courses, entablature breaks, 44 m apex, sightline maths) and dropped all the craft: smooth cylinders instead of fluted columns, flat bands instead of carved mouldings, an orange decal instead of a relief cartouche, painted stripes instead of raised gold, untextured cream instead of veined weathered marble. This is systemic across every prop in the game, not one landmark. Wrote docs/ORNAMENT-STANDARD.md: a shared ornament library (flute/moulding/dentils/coffer/relief/gold-trace/weather) + the 200 m / 40 m / 8 m acceptance rule. Headline item for wave 5.
